import pandas as pd, numpy as np
df=pd.read_csv('data.csv')
df['row_id']=np.arange(len(df))
exact=['pregnancies','glucose','blood_pressure','skin_thickness','insulin','age','outcome']
dups=[]
for key,grp in df.groupby(exact):
    if len(grp)<2: continue
    idx=grp.index.tolist()
    for i in range(len(idx)):
        for j in range(i+1,len(idx)):
            a,b=grp.loc[idx[i]],grp.loc[idx[j]]
            if abs(a.bmi-b.bmi)<=0.5 and abs(a.diabetes_pedigree-b.diabetes_pedigree)<=0.01:
                dups.append((idx[i],idx[j]))
print('near-dup pairs:',len(dups))
drop=set(max(p) for p in dups)  # keep the earlier row
print('rows to drop:',len(drop))
print('remaining:',len(df)-len(drop))
print('exact dups still in remaining?', df.drop(index=list(drop)).drop(columns='row_id').duplicated().sum())
"

import pandas as pd, numpy as np
df=pd.read_csv('data.csv')
exact=['pregnancies','glucose','blood_pressure','skin_thickness','insulin','age','outcome']
from collections import Counter
sizes=Counter()
for key,grp in df.groupby(exact):
    if len(grp)<2: continue
    sizes[len(grp)]+=1
print('group sizes on exact cols:',sorted(sizes.items()))
for thr_b,thr_p in [(0.5,0.01),(0.1,0.005),(0.05,0.002),(0.01,0.001)]:
    parent=list(range(len(df)))
    def f(x):
        while parent[x]!=x: parent[x]=parent[parent[x]]; x=parent[x]
        return x
    for key,grp in df.groupby(exact):
        idx=grp.index.tolist()
        for i in range(len(idx)):
            for j in range(i+1,len(idx)):
                a,b=df.loc[idx[i]],df.loc[idx[j]]
                if abs(a.bmi-b.bmi)<=thr_b and abs(a.diabetes_pedigree-b.diabetes_pedigree)<=thr_p:
                    parent[f(idx[j])]=f(idx[i])
    roots=len(set(f(i) for i in range(len(df))))
    print(thr_b,thr_p,'kept rows:',roots,'dropped:',len(df)-roots)
"

cd /home/daytona/workspace && python3 -c "
import pandas as pd, numpy as np
df=pd.read_csv('data.csv')
exact=['pregnancies','glucose','blood_pressure','skin_thickness','insulin','age','outcome']
drop=set()
for key,grp in df.groupby(exact):
    if len(grp)<2: continue
    idx=sorted(grp.index)
    for i in range(len(idx)):
        for j in range(i+1,len(idx)):
            a,b=df.loc[idx[i]],df.loc[idx[j]]
            if abs(a.bmi-b.bmi)<=0.05 and abs(a.diabetes_pedigree-b.diabetes_pedigree)<=0.002:
                drop.add(idx[j])
clean=df.drop(index=sorted(drop)).reset_index(drop=True)
print('dropped',len(drop),'kept',len(clean))
print(clean.outcome.value_counts().to_dict())
clean.to_csv('/tmp/clean.csv',index=False)
"
